summary: Park Hotels & Resorts filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it repaid in full and terminated the $1.275 billion HHV Mortgage Loan secured by the Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort, originally dated October 24, 2016, ahead of its November 1, 2026 maturity. Funding came from a previously disclosed $700 million delayed-draw Bonnet Creek mortgage financing plus a $600 million draw on an unsecured delayed-draw term loan. No price, premium, or board recommendation is stated; the event is a routine debt refinancing and collateral release, not a special situation. Watch for any associated property-level encumbrance changes.
